seo.home_desc: Discover premium natural skincare products handcrafted with African botanicals. Shop cleansers, serums, moisturizers and more. Nationwide delivery in Cameroon.
seo.about_desc: Learn about Thia — natural skincare from Cameroon, born from ancestral recipes and women's cooperatives.
seo.faq_desc: Find answers to the most common questions about delivery, payment, products and returns.
seo.contact_desc: Get in touch with the Thia team. We are here to help.

about.brand_p1: Thia was born from a simple idea: to bottle the ancestral wisdom of Cameroonian grandmothers. For generations, women across Cameroon have used the richness of African nature — shea butter, marula oil, baobab — to care for their skin, hair and bodies.
about.brand_p2: We work hand in hand with women's cooperatives in the Adamaoua, North West and Far North regions to source our raw materials directly from those who know them best. Every purchase supports local livelihoods and preserves ancestral know-how.
about.brand_p3: Our formulas are handcrafted in small batches, without parabens or harsh chemicals, to keep the integrity of each ingredient intact. Thia is not just skincare — it is a love letter to Cameroonian women and African nature.
about.why_natural_desc: Every ingredient sourced directly from African nature, chosen for its proven efficacy.
about.why_women_desc: We support women's cooperatives across Cameroon — every purchase empowers a community.
about.why_uncompromising_desc: Effective formulas, no parabens, no harmful additives — only what your skin needs.
about.ingredients_subtitle: From the heart of Cameroon's regions
about.shea_desc: Rich and nourishing, our shea comes from women's cooperatives in the Adamaoua highlands.
about.marula_desc: Lightweight and fast-absorbing, sourced from the lush hills of the North West region.
about.baobab_desc: The tree of life gives us this deeply regenerating oil from the Far North savannahs.
about.hibiscus_desc: Brightening and antioxidant-rich, harvested from the fertile valleys of the West.
about.cta_subtitle: Discover our range of natural skincare products, crafted with love in Cameroon.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Thia
faq.a_livraison_1: Yes, we deliver to all 10 regions of Cameroon through our logistics partners. Delivery times vary between 2 and 5 business days depending on your location.
faq.a_livraison_2: Delivery is free for all orders above 15,000 XAF. Below this threshold, delivery fees apply based on your region.
faq.q_livraison_3: How do I track my order?
faq.a_livraison_3: As soon as your order is shipped, you will receive an email with a tracking number.
faq.q_paiement_1: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a_paiement_1: We accept MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money.
faq.a_paiement_2: Yes. We use NotchPay, a certified and secure payment platform.
faq.a_produits_1: Yes, all our products are formulated with natural ingredients sourced from Cameroon and Africa.
faq.q_produits_2: Do you have products for sensitive skin?
faq.a_produits_2: Yes, several of our products are formulated for sensitive skin and are paraben-free.
faq.a_produits_3: Our products have a shelf life of 12 to 24 months depending on the range.
faq.a_retours_1: We accept returns within 7 days of receipt, provided the product is unopened.
faq.q_retours_2: How do I initiate a return?
faq.a_retours_2: Contact our customer service at hello@thia.cm with your order number.
faq.q_compte_1: How do I create an account?
faq.a_compte_1: Click on "Sign in" then "Create account" at the top of the page.
faq.q_compte_2: Can I modify an order after placing it?
faq.a_compte_2: Once confirmed, an order can no longer be modified. Contact us quickly if necessary.
